obtainedHow: Public records request filed through the Town of Bennett Town Clerk Public Records page (https://www.bennettco.gov/town-clerk/page/public-records). Town Clerk emailed the responsive PDFs as the records response. Not obtained from a third-party resident email.
notes: Exact copies of the Town Clerk records-response attachments. Town did not post these PDFs at a durable public file URL on its site. Separate from documents a concerned resident emailed the campaign (tax statement, Civic Lookup screenshots, bond closing image packs): those were reviewed for research, logged in the working doc, and deleted from the working folder; they are not hosted under public/sourced-records/. Prefer the issuer hub for new requests; do not treat DocAccess deep links as durable cites.
